neighbours.label: describing what a book, handout or edition contains (blurb register): verbs and counts announcing its contents ('with over sixty illustrations', 'these cases are described')
fire: Written for beginners, this guide to knitting includes more than eighty step-by-step patterns.
The second edition adds three new chapters on climate policy and an expanded glossary.
Each lesson in the workbook is followed by exercises and a short answer key.
The atlas contains over forty detailed maps of medieval Europe and its trade routes.
Richly illustrated, the volume features two hundred photographs from the archive.
The worked examples in the appendix are explained clearly and in full.
This anthology collects thirty short stories by writers from across Africa.
The manual covers installation, configuration and troubleshooting in nine chapters.
quiet: My neighbour has been knitting for years and gave me a warm scarf last winter.
The second week of the trip was rainy, so we stayed inside and played cards.
Each morning the dog waits by the door until someone takes it for a walk.
The old merchant travelled across Europe along the trade routes for decades.
Richly decorated, the hall was filled with guests from the village.
The kids in the park were laughing and chasing each other around the fountain.
My cousin moved to Kenya last year and works as a nurse in a clinic.
The mechanic fixed the engine, changed the oil and checked the brakes.

notes: Output suppresses ' book'/' books'; minus pole is 'the/this' before book. Probe: book blurbs 0.22-0.50, ordinary narrative 0.006.
